@Mozilla Club Bio Sheets https://jgmac1106.makes.org/thimble/MTE2NTI5NjEyOA==/mozilla-club-bio-sheets I made this from scratch today.

This http://codepen.io/melsumner/pen/EkzlG and this https://advocacy.mozilla.org/open-web-fellows/ served as inspiration but this is really one of the first things I have coded from storyboard through completion.

I still need to figure out my CSS layout a little better. Especially getting display:block down. I basically used a lot of padding to get things where I wanted them to go.
